title: Geotechnical Engineer
description:
We are seeking a skilled Geotechnical Engineer to lead quality assurance, compliance, and inspection efforts for civil infrastructure projects on Diego Garcia . This hands-on role focuses on geotechnical engineering practices—earthwork, excavation, backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation—ensuring strict adherence to US standards (USACE, EM 385-1-1), contractual obligations, and international codes (ISO, BS, EU). The Engineer will oversee testing, design, and maintenance of geotechnical elements in roads, bridges, and buildings.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement Project-Specific Quality Control Plans (QCP) in compliance with contract specifications, US Standards, and applicable international standards (e.g., ISO, USACE, EM 385-1-1), with a strong focus on geotechnical elements such as earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation.
  • Review design documents, technical specifications, and project plans to identify quality requirements, using computer-aided design (CAD) software and engineering principles to ensure civil/geotechnical infrastructure (e.g., roads, bridges, buildings) meets US Standards.
  • Perform daily inspections and surveillance of construction activities, including geotechnical assessments for earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, utility installation, concrete/steel testing, and site stability evaluations, to ensure compliance with approved plans, procedures, and project specifications.
  • Lead and Support the Three-Phase Control Process (Preparatory, Initial, and Follow-Up) and document all phases of work, with an emphasis on geotechnical risks, mitigations, and responsible charge oversight for earthwork and related activities.
  • Manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), implement corrective/preventive actions, and track resolution for issues related to geotechnical engineering, including excavation stability, backfilling compaction, pavement integrity, and utility installation.
  • Coordinate and supervise third-party testing laboratories, ensuring timely submittal and approval of test results for geotechnical materials (e.g., soil, aggregates) to BS, EU, and US Standards.
  • Oversee quality aspects of the construction, maintenance, and repair of civil infrastructure projects on Diego Garcia, with responsible charge for geotechnical components such as earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation, ensuring all work is performed in accordance with construction plans, specifications, and safety protocols.
  • Train and guide site personnel on quality standards, inspection protocols, documentation requirements, and geotechnical best practices, including safe handling of earthwork and utility-related tasks.
  • Maintain detailed QC documentation, including daily reports, inspection checklists, material submittals, test records, and CAD-generated plans for geotechnical-focused projects.
  • Interface with the client, project management, subcontractors, regulatory agencies, engineers, architects, and contractors on quality and geotechnical issues, providing technical support in a responsible charge role to ensure successful project completion.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of the quality system, recommend process improvements, and conduct/participate in internal audits while facilitating external quality audits as required.
  • Inspect civil infrastructure projects to ensure ongoing compliance with US Standards, project specifications, security, and safety procedures, including work in extreme weather conditions, with a focus on geotechnical stability and performance.

Qualifications & Requirements :

  • Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Licensed and registered as a Civil Engineer or Geotechnical Engineer in the United States of America (e.g., Professional Engineer (PE) certification).
  • At least 5 years of licensed experience, of which at least 3 years must be in responsible charge in geotechnical engineering practice or the type of work being performed on this project (e.g., earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation).
  • QC certification for relevant industries (e.g., geotechnical testing).
  • Significant material testing expertise to BS, EU, and US Standards.
  • Knowledge of US construction standards and codes (e.g., USACE, CQC).
  • Experience with government contracting, security, and safety procedures.
  • Hands-on experience in External & Internal Quality Audit Programmes, ISO Quality Management System, and quality tools/methodologies.

title: Senior Full Stack Web Application Developer
description:

  • Critical thinking
  • Analysis and design
  • Estimating
  • Planning

  • Experience building, delivering, and sustaining production, commercial-quality, n-tiered software architecture web-based applications

What YOU Get!

title: Customer Support Representative, Level 1

Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:

title: Senior Java Technical Lead (AI-Augmented Development)
description:
QAT Global , a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is seeking a highly skilled Senior Java Technical Lead to join our global engineering team. We deliver world-class technology solutions to clients across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil, with a strong culture of engineering excellence and innovation.

This is a full-time, 100% remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only), offering the opportunity to work directly with our US-based customer while collaborating with cross-functional, distributed teams.

About the Role

As a Senior Java Technical Lead , you will be responsible for leading all technical decision-making across backend and frontend development, ensuring architectural consistency, engineering best practices, and high-quality code delivery.

This role requires an expert-level Java professional who has begun integrating AI-assisted development workflows , including LLMs such as GPT and Claude, into their software engineering practices.

You will lead full-stack developers, collaborate closely with Solution Architects, BAs, DevOps, and AI Engineers, and oversee complex business domains such as Billing, Ledger, Invoice, and Remittance .

If you are a seasoned Java engineer who is also evolving into the new era of AI-enhanced software development, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

  • Lead all technical decision-making across backend and frontend architecture.
  • Ensure code quality, engineering best practices, and architectural coherence.
  • Guide full-stack developers implementing backend services and UI components.
  • Collaborate with Solution Architect, BA, DevOps, and AI Engineer to translate requirements into scalable, secure solutions.
  • Oversee complex financial and operational domains (Billing, Ledger, Invoice, Remittance).
  • Design, supervise, and optimize workflows that leverage LLMs for code generation, review, and refactoring.
  • Provide technical leadership on when and how to use AI tools safely and effectively.

Required Qualifications

Core Engineering Skills:

  • Senior-level Java/Spring Boot experience (expert level required).
  • Strong experience with Node.js , React , and Postgres .
  • Experience with Security, DevOps, Cloud , and GitHub ecosystem.
  • GitHub Advanced Security, GitHub CI/CD pipelines, and versioning best practices.

Cloud & Infrastructure:

  • Strong experience with AWS Identity Management .
  • Hands-on expertise with AWS workloads: EC2, RDS, SQS .

AI & LLM Experience (Required):

  • Solid understanding of LLMs and its capabilities.
  • Experience with Claude Sonnet 4.5 or similar models for:
  • Code generation
  • Code review
  • Code refactoring
  • Proficiency in prompt engineering , including:
  • Structured prompting
  • Chain-of-thought patterns
  • Constraints-driven prompting
  • Code-oriented prompting
  • Ability to guide developers on the safe, effective use of AI tools in daily engineering work.

Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)

  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical fields.
  • Experience leading distributed development teams.
  • Familiarity with modern architectural patterns and enterprise-level systems.

title: IT Applications and Analytics Analyst LATAM

Red Bull gives wings to all people, to fly in whichever direction they want, respecting and tolerating the trajectory of each one, regardless of gender expression, race, religion, affective-sexual orientation, origin, age or disability. In the world of Red Bull, everyone is welcome.

The IT Application & Analytics analyst LATAM acts upon the global IT strategy, is responsible for the IT relevant coordination and communication of global business applications, their deployments within the area and head-coach regions, supporting demand process and service ownership for regional and local business applications.

Job Description

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

· The IT Application & Analytics LATAM works thoroughly aligned with HQs BA service owners, HQ Data Team, BRMs and local peers of IT and business to ensure staying informed about relevant projects for counterparts in countries.

· The IT Application & Analytics analyst LATAM is responsible for service ownership and management of specific LATAM Analytics products.

· The IT Application & Analytics analyst LATAM is also responsible for assessing insights related demands from the different areas of the business (sales , logistics, marketing, etc), scoping the need and identifying the right technology together with it’s counterparts in LATAM or HQ. For the realization of analytics demands, the IT Application & Analytics analyst LATAM either relies on the skillset of other peers in the organization or will directly integrate and visualize data.

DEMAND CAPTURE & ALIGNMENT PROCESS SUPPORT

· Person acts as regional counterpart for Analytics requests.

· Capturing, scoping, documenting and prioritizing local demands (incl. HQ security or local privacy requirements).

· Thorough understanding of the underlying business case.

· Enabling the business-to-business communication.

· Ensuring a well-prepared and transparent decision process.

· Communication and explanation of taken decisions.

SUPPORTING SERVICE DELIVERY & PROJECTS

· Project oversight for global or regional projects.

· Project documentation and action plans on communication, training, handover, support.

· Stakeholder communication.

· Third Party Management.

· Satisfaction of business and users with new services or the operation throughout.

SUPPORTING SERVICE OWNERSHIP, OPERATION & CSI PROCESSES

· Service ownership for aligned and agreed regional services.

· Management and coordination of external support & development partners.

· Alignment with local and global service owners to ensure strategy fit of solutions.

· Alignment, development and maintenance of service roadmaps within the IT area.

· Ensure country requirements are communicated to global service owners.

· Regular review of operational KPIs to ensure insights on the service knowledge and performance are generated and improvement actions are derived.

ANALYTICS

· Assessing analytics demands from teams across the area LATAM.

· Performing user interviews to understand the different interests of the people involved.

· Analyzing the different data involved and their sources.

· Working with HQ Data committee to define a goal for the data visualization.

· Identifying data integration options, methods and technology.

· Aligning the approach with decision makers in the area LATAM and HQ.

· Support the realization process through externals or realization autonomously depending on the topic and the skill set.

· Closing demands ensuring success.

· Documenting and managing analytics use cases throughout their lifecycle.

Qualifications

Degree in computer science, business informatics or equivalent experience.

Strong communicator and relator, solid and broad business process understanding.

Project Management experience, ITIL knowhow beyond theory.

Team-oriented, self-driven and motivated personality, hands-on and flexible, thinking from the end.

Ability to understand complex and different types of requirements and translate those into technical concepts.

Excellent skills to interact with all levels of employees/executives.

Precise, systematic, accuracy and structured way of working.

Performance and result orientation.

Spoken and written English mandatory, Spanish a plus.

Strong mathematical skills to help collect, measure, organize and analyze data.

Interest or experience on working with analytics skills, such as data management and visualization.

Technical proficiency regarding database design development, data models, techniques for data mining and segmentation.

title: Trade Compliance Analyst
description:
Job Title: Regulatory Research Analyst

Location: Brazil

Work Mode: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (hourly pay, no benefits, and you’re responsible for your own taxes)

Contract Duration: 6 months (with possibility of extension)

Hours: 40 hours per week

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Regulatory Research Analyst to join the Tax & Regulations team of a global independent support provider. This fully remote role focuses on researching and tracking global trade regulations —primarily across LATAM and North America—and contributing insights that help keep SAP GTS systems up to date for global clients. The analyst will act as the first point of contact for new legal and regulatory changes and work closely with Business Analysts and ERP/GTS specialists. Client interaction is minimal; the role is primarily research-oriented.

Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Research & Analysis

  • Monitor and maintain up-to-date awareness of legislative and regulatory changes in assigned countries using government websites, agencies, third-party sources, and in-country experts.
  • Track global trade compliance regulations, including customs duties, export controls, sanctions, tariff updates , and other relevant requirements across jurisdictions (U.S., Canada, LATAM, etc.).
  • Interpret, analyze, and document new or amended legislation in an internal repository with high accuracy and clarity.
  • Prepare comparative analyses of regulatory changes when required.
  • Ensure research and documentation meet ISO process standards .

SAP GTS Alignment

Research and provide insights relevant to SAP GTS (v11 or similar), supporting product specialists on topics such as:

  • Export Control & Licensing
  • Import Control & Market Access
  • Sanctions & Restricted Party Compliance
  • Customs & Tariff Management
  • Trade Agreements & Origin Management
  • Regulatory Reporting & Declarations
  • Product & Classification Compliance

Collaboration & Documentation

  • Deliver clear summaries and detailed regulatory insights needed by ERP and product specialists to implement system changes for clients.
  • Collaborate with Business Analysts and fellow researchers to validate findings and maintain consistency.
  • Support research expansion into Indirect Tax topics (VAT, GST, country-specific filing requirements) where applicable.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Bilingual: English + one LATAM language (Spanish or Portuguese) .
  • 5+ years of professional experience in tax, global trade, or international regulatory research.
  • Working knowledge of SAP GTS or similar trade compliance systems.
  • Familiarity with international trade laws and frameworks (EAR, ITAR, EU Dual Use, WCO, etc.).
  • Strong research, analytical, and documentation skills with excellent attention to detail.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and handle multiple tasks under pressure.
  • Strong internet-based research capabilities and proficiency in business applications (Microsoft Office, Google tools, SharePoint, etc.).
  • Experience compiling complex regulatory information into clear, actionable summaries.
  • Technical understanding of SAP ERP tax/accounting workflows (advantageous, not mandatory).
  • Familiarity with tools like Excel, PDF generation, ABBYY FineReader, Deepl, Inoreader, Beyond Compare (training provided).
  • Self-starter with strong initiative, resourcefulness, and team-oriented mindset.
  • Additional background in finance or tax is a plus.

Why Join Us?

  • Work remotely while contributing to high-impact global compliance research.
  • Collaborate with a diverse international team of trade and tax experts.
  • Play a key role in helping global clients stay compliant with rapidly evolving regulations.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
As THE leader in transit technology, Clever Devices' vision is to make meaningful contributions to worldwide mobility. Our goal is to be the leading provider of exciting technology that improves the quality of mobility in communities around the world.

The Senior Project Manager is a transit industry veteran with a proven track record for leading the design, development, and implementation of Transit ITS projects. A dynamic leader, with excellent communications, interpersonal skills, acknowledged industry experience, the Senior Project Manager is responsible for leading project teams, managing resources, adherence to schedule performance, and managing the financials of projects throughout the full development life cycle. This also includes management of issues, risks, and project change requests to ensure successful and on-time project delivery.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Manage and plan with the Systems Engineering and Product/Engineering team leads for technical review of system design and documentation with the customer
  • Establishes a project plan and schedules according to established company practices, polices, tools and templates.
  • Establishes milestones and monitors adherence to program master plans
  • Manages financial schedule performance of assigned projects
  • Maintains and keeps scheduling of assigned projects and communicates schedule changes as necessary
  • Manages full lifecycle of project and ensures each aspect of the project is completed
  • Manages procurement of equipment and materials necessary to execute on projects
  • Develops subcontractors’ scopes of work, executes subcontracts and manages subcontractors as may be necessary
  • Coordinates with Sales and Account Managers to further sales opportunities
  • May coordinate proposal preparation, including standards of work and specifications, estimation of product and service costs.
  • May participate in negotiation and administration of contracts
  • Travel required for onsite at customers facility up to 40%
  • Adheres to company processes and policies.

Skills Required:

  • 10+ years’ experience as a Project Manager in a technical or engineering environment with a focus on delivering projects to external customers.

  • PMP certification or equivalent preferred.

  • Strong computer skills, including MS Office Suite, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook as well as ability to learn new software programs such as Microsoft Dynamics AX

  • Strong organizational skills
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Strong time management skills and ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Strong verbal and written communications, presentation, and persuasive skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Strong negotiation and influence skills

title: Analista de Sinistros Pleno
description:
SOBRE A SEDGEWICK:

Cuidar das pessoas está no centro de tudo o que fazemos, e começamos cuidando de você, nosso valioso colaborador. Uma carreira na Sedgwick significa entrar em contato com nossa cultura de cuidado. Uma carreira na Sedgwick é onde a paixão encontra o propósito de gerar um impacto positivo no mundo por meio das pessoas e organizações que servimos. Se você é uma pessoa motivada a fazer a diferença, que gosta de desafios e, acima de tudo, é uma pessoa que se importa, há um lugar para você aqui. Junte-se a nós e contribua para que a Sedgwick seja um ótimo lugar para trabalhar.

Great Place to Work®

Top 100 Most Loved Workplace®

Melhor empregador do estado de acordo com a Forbes

OBJETIVO PRINCIPAL: Realizar todas as etapas de um processo de regulação de sinistros. Seus principais objetivos incluem garantir uma resposta eficiente e eficaz aos sinistros relatados pelos segurados, assegurando uma resolução justa e satisfatória para todas as partes envolvidas. Atuar na análise detalhada das circunstâncias do sinistro, na avaliação dos danos e na determinação das coberturas aplicáveis à apólice de seguro. Conduzir as comunicações com os segurados, corretores, agentes e outros envolvidos no processo, esclarecendo dúvidas, fornecendo orientações e negociando acordos quando necessário. O Analista de Sinistros também trabalha em estreita colaboração com outras áreas internas, como jurídico, financeiro e atendimento ao cliente, para resolver pendências e garantir a conformidade com as políticas e regulamentações do setor de seguros. Suas atividades envolvem desde a coleta inicial de informações sobre o sinistro até a conclusão do processo, incluindo a liquidação de valores de indenização e o encerramento do caso de forma satisfatória para todas as partes. Este profissional tem um maior foco técnico, com uma relação mais profunda com as etapas de Regulação de Sinistros.

FUNÇÕES E RESPONSABILIDADES ESSENCIAIS:

  • Receber e registrar notificações de sinistros relatados por segurados, corretores ou agentes, e realizar uma análise inicial das circunstâncias do sinistro (pré-análise)
  • Conduzir investigações detalhadas sobre a validade e a extensão do sinistro, incluindo a avaliação de danos, coleta de evidências e entrevistas com testemunhas, quando necessário.
  • Realizar vistoria remota assistida através das tecnologias da Sedgwick coletando imagens para compor o laudo/processo do Sinistro, de acordo com as especificidades de cada ramo, condições gerais do produto e determinações dos Clientes.
  • Determinar a aplicabilidade das coberturas da apólice ao sinistro reportado, verificando os termos, condições e limitações da apólice de seguro.
  • Estabelecer comunicação com os segurados para fornecer orientações sobre o processo de regulação de sinistros, esclarecer dúvidas e solicitar documentação adicional, quando necessário.
  • Negociar acordos e resoluções com os segurados, corretores, agentes ou terceiros envolvidos no sinistro, com o objetivo de alcançar uma solução justa e satisfatória para todas as partes, quando aplicável ao escopo contratado pelos Clientes da Sedgwick.
  • Solicitar e coletar documentos relevantes relacionados ao sinistro, como registros médicos, estimativas de reparo, relatórios policiais e outros documentos necessários para a análise e avaliação do sinistro, de acordo com a documentação exigida por cada Cliente para as coberturas dos produtos comercializados.
  • Determinar a responsabilidade das partes envolvidas no sinistro e avaliar os impactos na resolução do sinistro, considerando as leis, regulamentos, condições gerais do produto, coberturas e demais aspectos do sinistro que está sendo analisado, resultando em um pagamento total, parcial ou a uma negativa de indenização.
  • Avaliar os danos causados pelo sinistro e determinar os valores de indenização de acordo com as coberturas da apólice e os procedimentos estabelecidos pela Seguradora.
  • Preparar relatórios detalhados sobre a investigação, análise e resolução do sinistro, documentando todas as etapas do processo e as decisões tomadas, de acordo com o Book de Regras de cada Cliente da Sedgwick.
  • Monitorar e gerenciar pendências relacionadas aos sinistros em aberto, garantindo que sejam resolvidas de forma oportuna e eficiente, buscando apoio das áreas internas da Sedgwick, Seguradora ou Corretora e/ou buscando solucionar pendências junto ao cliente, como por exemplo a obtenção de documentação complementar.
  • Registrar todas as atividades, decisões e informações relevantes sobre os sinistros nos sistemas de gerenciamento de sinistros da Sedgwick e/ou dos Clientes, garantindo a precisão e a integridade dos dados.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com outras áreas internas, como jurídico, atendimento ao cliente, financeiro e etc, para resolver questões e pendências relacionadas aos sinistros, buscando sua solução com a maior qualidade possível no menor tempo possível.
  • Acompanhar o progresso e o status dos processos de regulação de sinistros, fornecendo atualizações regulares aos segurados e outras partes interessadas conforme determinado no Book de Regras de cada Cliente, de acordo com as respectivas réguas de comunicação pré-estabelecidas assim como os canais disponíveis.
  • Garantir que todas as atividades e decisões relacionadas à regulação de sinistros estejam em conformidade com as leis, regulamentação SUSEP, condições gerais do produto e suas respectivas coberturas e especificidades determinadas pelos Clientes da Sedgwick formalizadas em um Book de Regras.

FUNÇÕES E RESPONSABILIDADES ADICIONAIS:

  • Executar análise e solucionar pendências.
  • Avaliar circunstâncias do sinistro e coberturas reclamadas vs coberturas contratadas
  • Obter informações e evidências relevantes (como vistorias e/ou documentos complementares)
  • Atender KPI's e SLA's e identificar oportunidade de melhorias.
  • Realizar acompanhamentos, buscar soluções e acionar áreas Internas da Sedgwick ou do Cliente dependendo da situação apresentada no contato, objetivando compartilhar o caso e buscar apoio com a solução de pendências.

REQUISITOS

Educação e licenças

  • Superior Completo ou Cursando: Administração, Negócios ou Correlatas, Ciências Atuariais, Economia ou Finanças ou Correlatas, Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Ciências da Computação ou Correlatas, Gestão de Seguros ou Gestão de Riscos ou Direito ou Engenharia.
  • Diferencial caso possua Certificações SUSEP.

Experiência

  • Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência em uma posição similar atuando em um dos ramos: Responsabilidade civil (RC), Riscos Nomeados e Compreensivo empresarial.
  • Experiência anterior em BPO's, seguradoras ou corretoras
  • Compreensão detalhada das políticas de seguros, incluindo termos, condições, coberturas e exclusões das apólices, para determinar a aplicabilidade ao sinistro.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de investigação para coletar evidências, realizar entrevistas e verificar informações relacionadas ao sinistro.
  • Capacidade de interpretar e analisar documentos legais relevantes para o sinistro, como apólices de seguro, relatórios policiais, registros médicos, contratos de locação entre outros.
  • Gerenciamento de documentos, incluindo verificação de integridade, organização e indexação adequada dos documentos
  • Conhecimento das leis e regulamentos que regem a indústria de seguros, incluindo legislação de seguros, responsabilidade civil, proteção ao consumidor e privacidade de dados.
  • Nível Intermediário – Pacote Office, com ênfase em Excel
  • Nível de Inglês Intermediário será considerado diferencial

Habilidades (Pleno) em:

  • Gestão do Tempo
  • Integração e Trabalho em Equipe
  • Empatia
  • Habilidade de Comunicação Assertiva
  • Pensamento Analítico
  • Proatividade e postura resolutiva

title: Head Global de Auditoria de Tecnologia
description:
Como esta é uma posição global, solicitamos que o currículo seja enviado em inglês.

A Stellantis é uma das principais fabricantes globais de automóveis e provedora de soluções de mobilidade limpa, conectada, acessível e segura. A força da nossa companhia vem da diversidade e paixão de nossas pessoas, da amplitude do nosso portfólio de marcas icônicas e das nossas raízes profundas nas comunidades onde atuamos.

Com operações industriais em quase 30 países, atendemos consistentemente às necessidades e expectativas dos consumidores em mais de 130 mercados, gerando valor para todos os nossos stakeholders.

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional para liderar o desenvolvimento estratégico da Auditoria de Tecnologia em nível global, garantindo alinhamento com as prioridades de negócio, governança de dados e padrões internacionais de excelência.

Principais Responsabilidades

Estratégia e arquitetura global de auditoria

  • Definir e executar o plano global de Auditoria de Tecnologia, alinhado às prioridades de risco corporativo e transformação.
  • Garantir cobertura dos principais riscos em TI, cibersegurança, software, plataformas digitais e ambientes em nuvem.

Execução de auditorias e comunicação executiva

  • Liderar auditorias globais de alta complexidade e comunicar insights, riscos e recomendações para liderança sênior e Comitê de Auditoria.
  • Assegurar padronização e consistência dos métodos, frameworks e reports.

Data, IA e automação na auditoria

  • Integrar IA, automação e análises avançadas às práticas de auditoria.
  • Desenvolver dashboards, modelos preditivos e ferramentas analíticas para aumentar a efetividade e velocidade das auditorias.

Governança e risco tecnológico

  • Garantir alinhamento com frameworks globais de Compliance, Segurança e Controles de TI.
  • Monitorar riscos emergentes e direcionar ações estratégicas.

Liderança global de times

  • Liderar equipes internacionais de auditores, especialistas em tecnologia e cientistas de dados.
  • Atrair, desenvolver e reter talentos estratégicos, promovendo inovação e colaboração global.

Stakeholder management

  • Ser um(a) advisor estratégico(a) para líderes C-level e áreas de tecnologia.
  • Influenciar decisões críticas sobre risco, segurança digital, arquitetura e transformação.

Requisitos

  • +15 anos de experiência em Auditoria Interna, Auditoria de Tecnologia, Data & Analytics ou Gestão de Riscos, sendo +5 anos em liderança global ou regional.
  • Vivência em transformação digital aplicada à auditoria, IA/ML ou automação.
  • Conhecimento sólido em controles de TI, cibersegurança, desenvolvimento de software e tecnologias em nuvem.
  • Experiência com plataformas e ferramentas de análise de dados (ex.: Power BI, Python, SQL).
  • Excelente comunicação executiva, influência organizacional e tomada de decisão.
  • Formação superior em Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia, Data Science, Contabilidade ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Certificações CIA, CISA ou similares são um diferencial.

Diferenciais da posição

  • Escopo e liderança global
  • Transformação digital aplicada à auditoria
  • Forte autonomia e impacto organizacional
  • Atuação em tecnologia avançada, Data e IA
  • Time internacional e ambiente multicultural

Diversidade e Inclusão

Na Stellantis, avaliamos candidatos com base em qualificações, mérito e necessidades do negócio. Encorajamos candidaturas de pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, idades, etnias, nacionalidades, religiões, orientações sexuais e pessoas com deficiência. Acreditamos que equipes diversas nos permitem atender melhor às necessidades em evolução de nossos clientes e cuidar do nosso futuro.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
This is a fully remote position working EST hours. This is a CLT position and salary range is 17k-23k BRL/mo.

Must-haves:

  • 3–5 years of professional experience as a DevOps Engineer
  • AWS Experience – EC2, Security Groups, Command Line usage
  • Terraform Experience – Command line and coding experience to stand up cloud infrastructure, create/modify resources, and update permissions on security groups (following existing formats)
  • Linux Environment – Experience with Amazon Linux, system maintenance, troubleshooting, and scripting for installation and deployment
  • Scripting & Automation – Ability to write scripts for deployment using Packer or Terraform

Day-to-Day:

In this role, you will support infrastructure and deployment operations for their technical products. Responsibilities include managing permissions, handling one-off requests via Slack, resolving access issues, and supporting releases for new services. You’ll be responsible for patching and maintaining cloud infrastructure, primarily in a Linux environment. You’ll use AWS (EC2, Security Groups) and Terraform to manage infrastructure as code, following established formats. Tasks also include scripting for deployment and collaborating with engineering teams to ensure smooth operations. Some exposure to Windows environments is acceptable, though the focus is on Amazon Linux.

title: Executivo de Vendas Presenciais de Soluções de Pagamentos - Mercado Pago - Campinas
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!

Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.

  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.

  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.

Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região: percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão).
  • Prospectar de forma estratégica: realizar abordagens porta a porta, 100% presenciais, com planejamento, disciplina e eficiência, superando metas e maximizando a satisfação das empresas credenciadas.
  • Garantir um excelente pós-venda: acompanhar o onboarding das empresas credenciadas, garantindo a ativação imediata, engajamento e principalidade de relacionamento com o Mercado Pago.
  • Competir em Equipe para Ganhar: participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais e coletivos.

Requisitos:

  • Possuir CNH "B” e Automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário.
  • Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).

Nós lhe propomos:

O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: Analista de FP&A Sênior "#982821"
description:
Quem Somos

“A DEXIAN é uma consultoria global de origem Americana focada em talentos para complementar a equipe de tecnologia da informação de nossos clientes. Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. Por mais de 25 anos, a DEXIAN® atende indústrias e clientes globais, em diversas áreas, com a missão de atrair e reter os maiores talentos do mundo.

Hoje somos orgulhosamente reconhecidos como uma das maiores empresas de “staffing augmentation” dos Estados Unidos pela Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

No Brasil, chegamos em 2007 e de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia.

O que esperar de nós

É importante que você saiba que por trás de cada movimento DEXIAN existem cinco valores fundamentais: colaboração, respeito, justiça, comprometimento e engenhosidade. Colaboração, justiça e respeito não são apenas palavras; comprometimento não é só um pensamento; e engenhosidade vai além de aspiração. Essas qualidades nos definem em todos os níveis, todas as parcerias e na forma como trabalhamos todos os dias. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A DEXIAN do Brasil incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.

Nosso Cliente

Essa vaga irá atender nosso cliente do segmento de Indústria.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

– Desenvolvimento do Orçamento: Colaborar na preparação de orçamentos anuais, trimestrais e/ou mensais em conjunto com a equipe financeira e outros departamentos relevantes. Isso inclui a identificação de metas financeiras, a previsão de receitas e despesas e a alocação de recursos.

– Análise de Desempenho Financeiro: Monitorar e analisar o desempenho financeiro real em relação ao orçamento planejado, identificando variações e suas causas. Fornecer relatórios e recomendações para melhorar o desempenho. Conciliar contas de receita e custo e participar ativamente das análises de vendas e da cadeia de suprimentos.

– Revisão e atualização do orçamento: Realize revisões periódicas dos orçamentos conforme novas informações e cenários em mudança surgem. Faça ajustes e atualizações conforme necessário.

– Relatórios: Preparar relatórios financeiros e apresentações para a alta administração e partes interessadas internas, comunicando os resultados orçamentários e propondo ações corretivas quando necessário.

– Gestão de Despesas: Apoiar a gestão de despesas da empresa, garantindo que os custos permaneçam dentro dos limites orçamentários e identificando oportunidades de otimização de custos. Participar dos fluxos de trabalho de aprovação de despesas e da configuração de sistemas internos.

– Apoio a Projetos Especiais: Participe de projetos especiais relacionados a finanças, como análises de viabilidade, investimentos e planejamento estratégico.

– Conformidade e Auditoria: Garantir que todas as transações financeiras estejam em conformidade com os regulamentos e as políticas internas da empresa. Fornecer suporte para auditorias internas e externas.

O que você precisa ter:

– Sólida experiência em FP&A (experiência anterior em funções de análise financeira ou orçamentária);

– Graduação em Finanças, Contabilidade, Administração de Empresas ou área correlata.

– Inglês Avançado ;

– Habilidades analíticas: Forte capacidade analítica com capacidade de interpretar dados e relatórios financeiros.

– Comunicação e trabalho em equipe: Boas habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar efetivamente em um ambiente de equipe.

– Atenção aos detalhes: Fortes habilidades organizacionais e atenção meticulosa aos detalhes.

– Ferramentas de escritório: Proficiência no Microsoft Office, especialmente habilidades avançadas no Excel.

– Conhecimento de sistemas: experiência com Oracle e Power BI é um diferencial

Inglês fluente obrigatório, irá falar com chineses diariamente, precisa saber falar termos técnicos, primeira etapa do processo será a validação em uma conversa.

Onde você vai trabalhar?

Atuação presencial em Pouso Alegre (avaliam profissionais que queiram se mudar para a região).

Modelo de Contrato:

CLT + benefícios diretamente pelo cliente.

title: Head Global de Auditoria de Tecnologia
description:
Posição: Head Global de Auditoria de Tecnologia

Como esta é uma posição global, solicitamos que o currículo seja enviado em inglês.

A Stellantis é uma das principais fabricantes globais de automóveis e provedora de soluções de mobilidade limpa, conectada, acessível e segura. A força da nossa companhia vem da diversidade e paixão de nossas pessoas, da amplitude do nosso portfólio de marcas icônicas e das nossas raízes profundas nas comunidades onde atuamos.

Estratégia e arquitetura global de auditoria

  • Garantir cobertura dos principais riscos em TI, cibersegurança, software, plataformas digitais e ambientes em nuvem.

Execução de auditorias e comunicação executiva

  • Liderar auditorias globais de alta complexidade e comunicar insights, riscos e recomendações para liderança sênior e Comitê de Auditoria.
  • Assegurar padronização e consistência dos métodos, frameworks e reports.

Data, IA e automação na auditoria

  • Integrar IA, automação e análises avançadas às práticas de auditoria.
  • Desenvolver dashboards, modelos preditivos e ferramentas analíticas para aumentar a efetividade e velocidade das auditorias.

Governança e risco tecnológico

  • Garantir alinhamento com frameworks globais de Compliance, Segurança e Controles de TI.

Liderança global de times

  • Liderar equipes internacionais de auditores, especialistas em tecnologia e cientistas de dados.

  • +15 anos de experiência em Auditoria Interna, Auditoria de Tecnologia, Data & Analytics ou Gestão de Riscos, sendo +5 anos em liderança global ou regional.
  • Vivência em transformação digital aplicada à auditoria, IA/ML ou automação.

Na Stellantis, avaliamos candidatos com base em qualificações, mérito e necessidades do negócio. Encorajamos candidaturas de pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, idades, etnias, nacionalidades, religiões, orientações sexuais e pessoas com deficiência. Acreditamos que equipes diversas nos permitem atender melhor às necessidades em evolução de nossos clientes e cuidar do nosso futuro.

title: FPGA Engineer (Brazil) | Engenheiro(a) de FPGA (Brasil)
description:
The Opportunity

Grass Valley’s FPGA Engineers develop state-of-the -art solutions for content creation, transmission, and distribution. We are dedicated to redefining the way audiences experience entertainment and information through cutting-edge technology. We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced FPGA Engineer specializing in Broadcast Video and Audio to join our team. As a FPGA Engineer, you will be instrumental in the design, development, testing and implementation of FPGA-based solutions specifically tailored for broadcast video and audio applications. Your responsibilities will encompass leading FPGA architecture design, electronic and PCB design and collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate these solutions into our broadcast systems.

Your Role

  • Lead the architecture, design, and development of FPGA-based systems for broadcast video and audio applications, focusing on Embedded System hardware and electronic design;
  • Optimize FPGA designs to enhance video processing, audio synchronization and develop electronic systems with FPGA architectures;
  • Conduct thorough simulation, testing, debugging, and verification of FPGA designs to ensure seamless functionality and adherence to industry standards;
  • Maintain and improve FPGA build processes using CI/CD tools like Jenkins;
  • Estimate work effort to establish schedules for design delivery;
  • Stay updated on industry trends, emerging standards, and technologies related to broadcast video and audio.

Who you are

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical field;
  • Two (2) to five (5) years experience in FPGA design and development with strong focus on electronic and PCB design;
  • Proficiency in FPGA design, power estimation, implementation, optimization, testing, and development using hardware description languages (HDL) such as VHDL or Verilog;
  • Ability to simulate and verify FPGA designs using tools like Questa;
  • Familiarity with FPGA development tools such as Xilinx Vivado, or Altera Quartus;
  • Proficiency in debugging and troubleshooting FPGA designs, including using logic analyzers and other debugging tools;
  • Ability to create clear and concise documentation for FPGA designs, including design specifications;
  • Experience with embedded system integration and real-time operating systems running on inhouse designed hardware;
  • Experience in high-speed digital design, data serialization, media streaming (ST2110) and transmission protocols within the broadcast industry, particularly HD-SDI video;
  • Experience with high-speed serial interfaces like PCIe, DDR, Ethernet, and USB;
  • Knowledge of communication protocols such as SPI, I2C, UART, and CAN;
  • Strong understanding of digital logic design principles and ability to create complex digital circuits;
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python and programming languages C/C++ for FPGA programming and automation;
  • Understanding TCP/IP from network programming perspective;
  • Experience in managing code with version control systems like Git to track releases and collaborate with a team through branching and merging;
  • Strong teamwork and communication skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional multi-site teams, including hardware engineers, QA engineers, and project managers;
  • Proven experience in hardware design and development, preferably in a similar role;
  • Experience with hardware debug and tests;
  • Strong knowledge of analog and digital electronics, microcontrollers, and FPGA;
  • Familiarity with industry standards, regulations, and compliance related to hardware design;
  • Proficiency in schematic capture and oversight of PCB layout;
  • Fluency in English, both oral and written.

Working Conditions

  • Competitive Compensation packages
  • Energizing and supportive work environment
  • Remote work

______________________________________________________________

  • This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work involved for this job. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of this job.
  • Grass Valley is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to gender, marital status, race, religion, colour, age, disability, sexual orientation or protected veteran status.

_______________________________________________________________

Oportunidade

Os Engenheiros FPGA da Grass Valley desenvolvem soluções de ponta para criação, transmissão e distribuição de conteúdo. Somos dedicados a redefinir a forma como as audiências vivenciam entretenimento e informação por meio de tecnologia inovadora.

Estamos buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) FPGA altamente qualificado(a) e experiente, especializado(a) em Vídeo e Áudio Broadcast, para integrar nossa equipe. Como Engenheiro(a) FPGA você será fundamental no design, desenvolvimento, teste e implementação de soluções baseadas em FPGA, especificamente voltadas para aplicações de Vídeo e Áudio Broadcast. Suas responsabilidades incluirão liderar o design de arquitetura FPGA, design eletrônico e de PCB, além de colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para integrar essas soluções aos nossos sistemas de transmissão.

Função

  • Liderar a arquitetura, design e desenvolvimento de sistemas baseados em FPGA para aplicações de vídeo e áudio broadcast, com foco em hardware de sistemas embarcados e design eletrônico;
  • Otimizar designs FPGA para aprimorar o processamento de vídeo, sincronização de áudio e desenvolver sistemas eletrônicos com arquiteturas FPGA;
  • Realizar simulação, testes, depuração e verificação detalhada dos designs FPGA para garantir funcionalidade perfeita e conformidade com padrões da indústria;
  • Manter e melhorar processos de build FPGA usando ferramentas CI/CD como Jenkins;
  • Estimar esforço de trabalho para estabelecer cronogramas de entrega de design;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências da indústria, padrões emergentes e tecnologias relacionadas a vídeo e áudio broadcast.

Quem é você

  • Graduado em Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia da Computação ou área técnica relacionada;
  • De 2 a 5 anos de experiência em design e desenvolvimento FPGA com forte foco em design eletrônico e de PCB;
  • Proficiência em design FPGA, estimativa de consumo, implementação, otimização, testes e desenvolvimento usando linguagens de descrição de hardware (HDL) como VHDL ou Verilog;
  • Capacidade de simular e verificar designs FPGA usando ferramentas como Questa;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento FPGA como Xilinx Vivado ou Altera Quartus;
  • Proficiência em depuração e solução de problemas em designs FPGA, incluindo uso de analisadores lógicos e outras ferramentas de debug;
  • Capacidade de criar documentação clara e concisa para designs FPGA, incluindo especificações de design;
  • Experiência com integração de sistemas embarcados e sistemas operacionais em tempo real rodando em hardware desenvolvido internamente;
  • Experiência em design digital de alta velocidade, serialização de dados, streaming de mídia (ST2110) e protocolos de transmissão na indústria broadcast, especialmente vídeo HD-SDI;
  • Experiência com interfaces seriais de alta velocidade como PCIe, DDR, Ethernet e USB;
  • Conhecimento de protocolos de comunicação como SPI, I2C, UART e CAN;
  • Forte compreensão dos princípios de design lógico digital e capacidade de criar circuitos digitais complexos;
  • Proficiência em linguagens de script como Python e linguagens de programação C/C++ para programação FPGA e automação;
  • Compreensão de TCP/IP sob a perspectiva de programação de rede;
  • Experiência em gerenciamento de código com sistemas de controle de versão como Git para rastrear releases e colaborar com a equipe por meio de branching e merging;
  • Fortes habilidades de trabalho em equipe e comunicação para colaborar efetivamente com equipes multifuncionais distribuídas, incluindo engenheiros de hardware, QA e gerentes de projeto;
  • Experiência comprovada em design e desenvolvimento de hardware, preferencialmente em função similar;
  • Experiência com debug e testes de hardware;
  • Sólido conhecimento em eletrônica analógica e digital, microcontroladores e FPGA;
  • Familiaridade com padrões da indústria, regulamentações e conformidade relacionadas ao design de hardware;
  • Proficiência em captura esquemática e supervisão de layout de PCB;
  • Fluência em inglês, oral e escrita.

Condições de Trabalho

  • Ambiente de trabalho estimulante e colaborativo

description:

You are an enthusiastic, detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with people and solving problems.

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in Customer Support, Account Management, or a related service field (preferably within digital products).

  • Third with the department director. If we are a perfect match, this interview might just end with a job offer.

title: Data Research Analyst
description:
REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 3-5 years of data analysis and reporting experience
  • Advanced experience writing and creating large-scale surveys (QuestionPro, Qualtrics), analyzing results/data, and developing actionable findings
  • Experience with Tableau for data visualization
  • Experience in writing detailed reports and presenting data findings/analysis.

NICE TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Passion for video games/gaming in order to assist in writing and interpreting survey questions
  • Experience with SQL writing data queries
  • Snowflake or Data Bricks experience

Insight Global is hiring a Data Research Analyst to support the User Experience Research team at a leading company in the Gaming industry. The main role of the Data Research Analyst will be to create, send, and analyze large-scale surveys intended to learn about the player base of the core gaming products.

Job Functions

-Create surveys and trackers to support all products and initiatives

  • Design questions that do not bias respondents
  • Use best practice methodologies to produce actionable, accurate, and representative data.

-Advanced, survey focused, data visualizations (Tableau, Excel, Sheets)

  • Creating clear reports and dashboards based on surveys sent to players and users of their products.

-Data queries (HIVE, Snowflake, Tableau)

  • Querying multiple types of databases and plugging data queries directly into tools like Tableau are essential for this role. These skills will be used to target audiences for survey sends, pull in additional analytics to identify respondents, and allow for advanced data visualizations.

-Report writing and presenting data

  • Writing detailed and understandable reports that will speak to a variety of audiences across the enterprise
  • Presenting data in meetings and providing additional relevant context where applicable.

-Act as backup for all functions of current data researchers

-Provide support to UX researchers on report creation that involves data visualization.

-Quickly pivot with new data to ensure a constant flow of player insights are output as updated player survey data is received to ensure we are always reporting on timely and relevant findings.

-Contribute to overall needs of the UXR team e.g. peer review, supporting other teams with survey expertise, etc.

-Contribute survey expertise to assist others in the company with the creation of surveys.

title: Systems Engineer
description:
As THE leader in transit technology, Clever Devices' vision is to make meaningful contributions to worldwide mobility. Our goal is to be the leading provider of exciting technology that improves the quality of mobility in communities around the world.

This role will cover either our open B (4PM - 12PM) and C (12PM-8AM) shift as well as weekends.

Job Summary:

The Systems Engineer is responsible for leading the deployment of complete systems that include Clever Devices products combined with complementary technologies, including deployment of hardware products and interfaces, to provide a holistic solution that meets customer requirements.

The Systems Engineer works closely with the project team to analyze the customer requirements and required functionality early in the project cycle; create design documents, system architecture, requirement matrix and support the customer design reviews, conduct the Factory Acceptance Testing with the customer and lead the subsequent deployment at the Customer site. Execute and complete the System Acceptance Testing along with the customer and all other parties involved in the project

The Systems Engineer coordinates all system development and integration tasks to include design, integration and formal testing. The Systems Engineer also works to support the Systems Engineering team.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Supports the definition of software and hardware products and interfaces
  • Coordinates system development tasks to include design, integration and formal testing
  • Oversees all transitions into customer’s deployment
  • Develops and completes projects in system specifications, technical and logistical requirements and other disciplines
  • Creates and maintains programmatic and technical documentation (design docs, requirement matrix, system diagrams, etc) to insure efficient planning and execution
  • Manages and documents system configurations
  • Ensures the deployment of the solution is successful
  • Maintains a thorough working knowledge of enterprise applications such as BusTime and CleverCAD
  • Implements Performance analysis and reliability analysis of the end to end protocol
  • Adheres to protocol revisions and amendments as directed by the Regional Systems Engineering Manager
  • Assists in other tasks as needed by the Systems Engineering department
  • Provides training and guidance to Associates, Project Engineer I/II as needed.

Skills Required:

  • 10+ years experience in engineering development
  • 10+ years experience in systems engineering involving hardware, software, data and communications technologies
  • Good understanding of the J1939 and J1708 protocols and experience with Multiplex systems
  • Hardware design experience and ability to read electrical schematics
  • Experience with hardware troubleshooting and lab equipment
  • Experience with network and protocol troubleshooting and tools
  • Working knowledge of one or more of the following: C and C++, SQL, VB, JavaScript, HTML, ASP, python, databases, report generation and networking
  • Ability to independently gather and document requirements and provide design requirements and product definition
  • Strong computer skills particularly with MS Office including Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint and Project.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and prioritize
  • Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills
  • Strong written and oral communication skills
  • Bachelors Degree in Engineering or Computer Engineering required, Masters Degree in related discipline.
  • Experience working with public transit is a plus

title: Planner de Seguros de Vida
description:

title: Cloud/AI Engineer
description:
Position Summary:

Global Technology - Digital & Innovation team is committed to empowering our business through impactful solutions using Cloud & AI. This team is crucial in building efficient, cutting-edge solutions leveraging AI to bring transformative value to the organization.

We are seeking a "Senior Engineer – Cloud & AI" to drive the development through deployment of cutting-edge cloud-native AI solutions. This role requires a combination of deep technical expertise in Microsoft Azure, strong DevOps and CI/CD practices, and an engineering mindset focused on delivering impactful and value-centric solutions. The ideal candidate is a collaborative team player who thrives in both research-oriented problem solving and timeline-driven execution. The individual comes with a proven background on deploying Generative AI workloads (LLM’s, LVM’s, TTS, Speech to Text etc.) cloud native, with “Security by design” using Commercial (for ex: Azure OpenAI), or Open-source (for ex: Llama, Mistral etc.) models.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Drive the design, development, and deployment of cloud-native Generative AI solutions on Microsoft Azure.
  • Implement and maintain DevOps best practices, including CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and version control using GitHub or Azure DevOps.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, AI/ML teams, and business stakeholders to deploy and optimize AI models within cloud-native architectures, ensuring seamless integration and performance at scale.
  • Drive cloud architecture decisions in partnership with Enterprise Architecture, TechOps, and Cybersecurity functions, ensuring scalability, security, and cost efficiency
  • Build and manage CI/CD pipelines to streamline the deployment process and ensure rapid delivery of high-quality applications.
  • Advocate and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to automate infrastructure provisioning, ensuring consistency across environments.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, promoting a culture of teamwork and innovation.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring team members, and fostering a continuous learning environment.
  • Stay up to date with the latest trends in Azure services, AI technologies, and DevOps practices to recommend innovative solutions.

Standard Job Requirements:

  • Experience in Microsoft Azure : Deep understanding of Azure services, including but not limited to Azure Virtual Machines, Azure Container Apps Environment, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions, and Azure Cognitive Services.
  • Experience in Generative AI : Experience working on full-stack Gen AI solution deployments through rapid-prototyping, MVP to Production grade enterprise solutions both with Commercial, Open source models, and Generative AI frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex etc., with deeper understanding of Global AI regulations, and AI Governance.
  • DevOps & CI/CD : Proven experience in DevOps practices, including setting up and managing CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
  • Infrastructure as Code : Hands-on experience with IaC tools such as Terraform, ARM templates, or Bicep.
  • AI Integration : Experience in integrating AI/ML models into cloud solutions to enhance business processes and outcomes.
  • Strong Engineering with Research Mindset : Ability to approach problems with a research-oriented mindset, exploring new technologies and methods to achieve optimal solutions.
  • Value-Centric Approach : Ability to balance timelines and deliverables with a strong focus on delivering value-driven solutions.
  • Collaborative & Independent : Excellent team player who can collaborate effectively across teams but is also capable of working independently with minimal supervision.

Education, Experience & Soft skills:

  • Minimum Bachelor's degree (Masters Degree preferred) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related fields.
  • Experience in Cloud & AI, with Generative AI
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to engage with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and deliverables simultaneously.
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and frameworks.

title: Analista de Suporte de Sistemas / Digital (Foco em Bitrix24 - RD Station)
description:
Proposta de Serviço PJ: Analista Operacional Digital / Freelancer

Local: Remoto (dentro do Brasil)  Modalidade: Contrato PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) / Freelancer.

Sobre a Nacionalitália

A Nacionalitália é uma empresa especializada em serviços de cidadania italiana, AIRE e suporte a brasileiros e ítalo-descendentes em fase de rápida expansão. Buscamos um parceiro PJ experiente em gestão de sistemas digitais para garantir a manutenção e a eficiência das nossas operações.

O Contrato de Prestação de Serviços

Buscamos um profissional  PJ para um contrato mensal de  retainer (pacote de horas) com foco em longo prazo. O serviço será estritamente de consultoria e suporte técnico especializado,  sem vínculo empregatício (CLT) .

Escopo do Serviço (O que esperamos)

O serviço será focado na  execução técnica, na manutenção e no suporte operacional dos sistemas , atuando como braço direito técnico da Direção.

Suporte e Manutenção de Bitrix24 (CRM)

  • Solução de  bugs , erros de  workflow e problemas de integração diários ( troubleshooting ) no ambiente CRM, Tasks e Documentos.
  • Manutenção da qualidade e integridade dos dados ( data quality ) no sistema.
  • Realização de pequenos ajustes de configuração e personalizações no CRM conforme as necessidades operacionais.

Operações e Fluxos de Marketing (RD Station)

  • Execução dos Fluxos: Construção, revisão e manutenção técnica de Fluxos de Automação de Marketing no  RD Station (baseados na estratégia definida pela Direção).
  • Suporte Técnico de MKT: Auxílio na integração de  landing pages , formulários e demais ativos digitais com o RD Station.
  • Acompanhamento e ajuste da performance técnica dos  workflows (taxas de entrega, erros).

Suporte Técnico Geral

  • Atuar como  interface técnica com fornecedores externos de automação complexa para garantir a estabilidade das implementações.
  • Suporte pontual na integração técnica entre sistemas (Bitrix24, RD Station e ferramentas de terceiros).

Requisitos Obrigatórios do PJ

  • Experiência comprovada como Consultor ou Analista PJ em projetos com  Bitrix24 e RD Station .
  • Capacidade de resolução de problemas ( troubleshooting ) autônoma e eficiente.
  • Proatividade, excelente organização e habilidade de comunicação para relatar o trabalho.
  • Possuir CNPJ ativo (Pessoa Jurídica).

Remuneração e Contrato

  • Contrato: Mensal ( Retainer ), renovável.
  • Remuneração (Pacote de Horas/Serviço): Valor total PJ, a depender da experiência e do escopo acordado.
  • Cláusula de Confidencialidade (NDA): Obrigatória e detalhada em contrato para proteção dos dados da Nacionalitália.

title: Content Writer (Portuguese) - 53457
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Content Writer to create and refine content used in workflows, training data, and scenario-based evaluations for large language models (LLMs). You will help build realistic content samples, review AI-generated outputs, and ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency.

What does day-to-day look like:

  • Create and edit content across formats such as articles, guides, workflows, and scenarios.
  • Recreate real-world content workflows for AI evaluation.
  • Review AI outputs for quality, accuracy, and adherence to guidelines.
  • Provide feedback and annotations to support LLM improvement.
  • Collaborate with product and AI teams to align content with operational needs.

Required Qualifications:

  • 2+ years experience as a Content Writer, Copywriter, or Technical Writer.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify content gaps or inconsistencies.
  • Familiarity with documentation or workflow tools (e.g., Confluence, Notion, Zendesk, Jira).
  • Excellent written communication skills.

Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : at least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 1 month

Evaluation Process :

  • Shortlisted candidates will be reviewed by our team internally and shortlisted candidates will be reached out for onboarding.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Job Title: Data Engineer

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: Full Time

Compensation: Competitive hourly rate, commensurate with experience

About Design Manager

Design Manager (+DesignSpec) is a leading provider of project management and accounting software tailored specifically for interior design firms. For over 30 years, we’ve helped thousands of designers run more efficient, profitable businesses with our cloud-based platform that integrates purchasing, budgeting, time tracking, and client communication in one seamless solution. As we grow, we're investing heavily in our data infrastructure to enhance product capabilities and improve client outcomes.

About the Role

We’re seeking a skilled Data Engineer to support our product and technology team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for building and maintaining data pipelines, analyzing data, and enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization. You'll be the first and only dedicated data analytics team member , so we’re looking for someone with an entrepreneurial mindset who is comfortable operating independently, defining structure, and solving complex data challenges.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL processes
  • Clean, validate, and structure raw data from various sources to ensure data quality and usability
  • Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights that support business decision-making
  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations to communicate key performance metrics to stakeholders
  • Work cross-functionally with teams (e.g., finance, operations, marketing) to define data needs and solve business problems using data
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand and meet data requirements
  • Develop data models and schemas for analytics and reporting
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data pipelines for performance and reliability
  • Support the design and implementation of a modern data warehouse architecture
  • Ensure data quality, governance, and security best practices are followed
  • Work with third-party APIs and internal tools to extract, transform, and load data
  • Demonstrate an entrepreneurial, self-starter attitude as the inaugural data analytics hire

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in data engineering or a related field
  • Proficiency in SQL and experience with Python or another scripting language
  • Experience analyzing large datasets and generating insights that drive business impact
  • Familiarity with dashboarding and analytics platforms such as Mode, Power BI, or similar
  • Hands-on experience with modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift)
  • Experience with ETL tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, Fivetran) and data pipeline orchestration
  • Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and data modeling
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with minimal oversight

Nice to Have

  • Experience in SaaS or B2B software environments
  • Exposure to finance or accounting domains

Why Join Us

  • Competitive hourly compensation
  • High-impact role with significant autonomy and visibility
  • Opportunity to shape the foundation of data and analytics at a growing SaaS company
  • Collaborative and mission-driven team environment
  • Possibility for contract extension or full-time conversion based on performance and business needs

This is a full on-site position at our São Paulo – Berrini office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, monitor, and close telecom projects (RAN, Core, IP, FTTH, DWDM, power and site infrastructure).
  • Manage project scope, schedule, budget, and quality indicators (SLAs, KPIs), ensuring compliance with contractual obligations and customer requirements.

  • Prepare and present executive reports to clients and senior management, highlighting progress, risks, and key decisions.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related fields.
  • Postgraduate degree or MBA in Project Management, Telecommunications, or related areas is highly desirable.
  • Proven experience in project management, with a strong background in the telecommunications sector.
  • Solid experience in project management within the telecommunications sector (mobile networks, fixed networks, or backbone).
  • Strong technical knowledge of telecom technologies (4G/5G RAN, IP/MPLS, DWDM, FTTH, power and infrastructure for telecom sites).
  • Proven experience managing projects of high complexity, involving multiple vendors and Tier-1 telecom operators.
  • Knowledge of project management methodologies (PMBOK, Agile, hybrid).
  • Certifications are a plus: PMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum Master, ITIL.
  • English is the primary working language; fluency is required. Portuguese fluency both written and spoken is a must.
  • Availability to work full on-site at the São Paulo – Berrini office.

Preferred Competencies

  • Strong leadership skills and ability to engage technical and field teams.

  • Established professional relationship with major Brazilian telecom operators (TIM, Claro, Vivo, Oi/Algar) is highly desirable.
  • Analytical thinking and result-oriented mindset.

  • Clear and structured communication for both technical and executive audiences.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package and continuous training programs.

5) Excelência Operacional

• Participar dos rituais de melhoria contínua da equipe.

Investimos no desenvolvimento de nossos talentos, oferecendo treinamento contínuo através da nossa “Wine Academy”. Valorizamos a autenticidade e a iniciativa, proporcionando um espaço onde você pode florescer. Junte-se a uma empresa com 39 anos de história e uma presença consolidada no mercado.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
QAT Global – 100% Remote (Brazil Only – CLT hire)

QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is seeking highly-skilled Java Full-Stack Developers with strong English communication skills to join our global engineering team. You will collaborate directly with our US-based customer and work with distributed development teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.

About the Role

As a Java Full-Stack Developer, you will be responsible for building mission-critical backend services and front-end components that support a large-scale financial platform. You will work across domains involving profiles, billing, ledger, invoicing, and payment flows, contributing to both core business logic and customer-facing UI experiences.

This role requires strong expertise in modern full-stack engineering combined with practical experience using AI-assisted development workflows , LLMs, and prompt engineering to accelerate delivery while maintaining high quality.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain backend services across key financial modules (Profile, Billing, Ledger, Invoice, Recurring, Receipt, Remittance).
  • Build and enhance front-end components used in the Administration UI and Payment Widget.
  • Implement business logic, domain models, API endpoints, and cross-service integrations.
  • Work with frameworks defined by the architecture team (likely Java/Kotlin on the backend, TypeScript/React on the frontend).
  • Collaborate closely with QA engineers to ensure functional completeness and application stability.
  • Use AI-assisted workflows to generate code, improve documentation, and create automated tests.
  • Participate in agile ceremonies and work effectively with distributed teams.

Required Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience with Java (Spring Boot) , Node.js , and React .
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and relational data modeling.
  • Familiarity with Security / DevOps / Cloud practices.
  • Knowledge of GitHub CI/CD pipelines , versioning, and workflow automation.
  • Practical usage of GitHub Advanced Security (CodeQL, secret scanning, dependency checks).
  • Experience with AWS IAM (roles, policies, permission boundaries).
  • Experience deploying or maintaining workloads on EC2 , RDS , and SQS .
  • Working knowledge of LLM capabilities applied to software development (code generation, code review, refactoring, writing automated tests, requirement analysis).
  • Experience with Claude Sonnet 4.5 or willingness to learn quickly.
  • Ability to apply prompt engineering techniques to:
  • debug and reason about code
  • generate high-quality and consistent implementations
  • enforce architectural patterns and constraints
  • interpret technical and business requirements
  • Understanding of safe and responsible AI usage, including hallucination mitigation, validation steps, and code verification.
  • Basic familiarity with AI-powered IDEs (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, JetBrains AI Assistant, etc.).

Preferred Qualifications

  • BS/MS in Systems Analysis and Development, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent fields.

title: Full-Stack Developer (React Native + Python / FastAPI / AWS)
description:

PhilSocial is a blockchain-powered Give-to-Earn platform transforming how social media influences the world. You’ll join a cross-functional global team (Brazil, USA, Dubai, Spain, Ukraine, Colombia, and more) responsible for building new, complex features for the next phase of PhilSocial — while maintaining and improving current modules of our social media platform.

You’ll work remotely and collaborate daily with our Tech Lead in Brazil and Corporate Teams in the US and Dubai .

  • Implement RESTful and asynchronous APIs using FastAPI , aligned with DDD and Hexagonal Architecture principles.
  • Collaborate with designers, blockchain engineers, and backend specialists to build seamless user experiences.
  • Contribute to system architecture discussions and participate in technical design reviews.
  • Write well-tested, documented, and maintainable code following Clean Code / SOLID practices.

title: System Engineer
description:
Shape the Future of Automotive Technology with KPIT!

KPIT is a global leader in providing technology solutions and services to the automotive and mobility industries. We are expanding our team in Betim and seeking talented HIL Validation Engineers to join us. We are hiring for 4 positions at both Mid-Level (2-5 years of experience) and Advanced Level (5-9 years of experience). This is a Hybrid role with an 8.5-hour workday.

Role Overview:

As a HIL Validation Engineer, you will be responsible for the validation of Body domain ECUs using state-of-the-art dSPACE HIL systems. You will play a crucial role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our automotive software solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) validation for Body domain ECUs using dSPACE HIL systems (PHS/Scalexio).
  • Connect ECUs, sensors, and actuators to the LabCar environment; manage wiring harness and breakout box testing.
  • Commission HIL rigs and debug hardware/software integration issues.
  • Develop HIL test specifications, create test cases, procedures, and generate comprehensive test reports.
  • Automate HIL tests utilizing Python or CAPL scripting.
  • Analyze test failures and perform root cause analysis within the test environment.
  • Ensure compliance with Agile processes, the V&V lifecycle, and ASPICE standards.

Mandatory Skills:

  • Hands-on experience with dSPACE HIL hardware (ControlDesk, AutomationDesk, ConfigurationDesk).
  • Solid knowledge of CAN/LIN protocols, UDS services, and ECU diagnostics.
  • Familiarity with Vector tools: CANoe, CANalyzer, CANape for communication setup and analysis.
  • Strong debugging skills related to ECU functional software and the HIL environment.
  • Experience with test automation frameworks and scripting languages (Python/CAPL).
  • Experience with requirement management tools: DOORS, PREEVision.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience in BCM (Body Control Module) validation or HVAC system testing.
  • Knowledge of CAN-FD, FlexRay, and Ethernet communication protocols.
  • Understanding of HIL simulator models (dSPACE) and ARXML models.
  • Exposure to multi-ECU HIL setups and integration testing.

Tools & Technologies:

  • dSPACE: ControlDesk, AutomationDesk, ConfigurationDesk.
  • Vector tools: CANoe, CANalyzer, CANape.
  • MATLAB/Simulink for plant modeling.
  • Requirement tools: DOORS, RTC.
  • Debugging tools: Trace32, Wireshark.

Protocols:

  • CAN
  • LIN
  • FlexRay
  • Ethernet
  • UDS (ISO14229)

To Apply:

Please submit your application with an English-language resume/CV.
